invariants.rule: Every authority JSON entry's verification_status must be internally consistent with its verification_note/citation_note - VERIFIED_PRIMARY_SOURCE requires a direct fetch of the case's own text and (in this codebase's convention) a primary_source_link; anything confirmed only via a later citing judgment must be VERIFIED_SECONDARY_SOURCE.

citation_lint.py's CITATION_PATTERNS entries must stay group-free (return plain strings from findall()) - reporter-name extraction uses a separate regex (_US_REPORTER_WITH_GROUP) rather than adding a capture group to the shared pattern.

A source's access-block (e.g. BAILII HTTP 403) is final - no proxy, cache, archive mirror, or alternate-tool workaround (including opening a blocked URL in a browser-automation tool after direct fetch was refused) is legitimate, regardless of how narrow the intended use.

contradictions.description: docs/HONEST_STATUS.md's 0.1.4-0.1.5 update note and LEGAL_CHAMBERS_STRESS_TEST_REPORT.md both asserted 'no populated case-law Authority Graph in any jurisdiction' and 'no programmatic API' as still-open, while both gaps had already been closed in 0.1.6 (legal_api.py) and 0.1.6/0.1.7 (Authority Graph). Version-snapshot notes in this repo are not automatically updated when the thing they describe as missing gets built later.

AI-transcribed content (authority JSON files written from a research agent's prose report, not copy-pasted) is prone to introducing false-precision detail (exact dates) that the underlying source never actually stated - confirmed in 9 of 25 date fields across the England & Wales authority files in this run. The bug pattern: a report gives only the year, and the transcriber fills in a specific day/month from general knowledge without flagging it as unsourced.

assumptions.claim: scripts/data/reporters.json (vendored from Free Law Project's reporters-db) stays a faithful, unmodified copy of the upstream data - citation_lint.py trusts it without re-verifying entries against the live upstream repo.
Every markdown cross-reference (relative path, table row naming a file, schema field name mentioned in prose) added or touched across this session's ~20 edited/new files resolves to something real.
